normative_extracts.quote: Brotli is a generic-purpose lossless compression algorithm that compresses data using a combination of a modern variant of the LZ77 algorithm, Huffman coding and 2nd order context modeling.
Compression Dictionary Transport defines a mechanism for using designated HTTP responses as an external dictionary for compressing future HTTP responses.

browser_support.notes: Static Brotli (br) is widely supported; Compression Dictionary Transport (dcb/dcz) is newly available in Chromium and rolling out across engines.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Compresses text payloads with Brotli (br) and uses previously cached responses as shared LZ77 dictionaries (dcb/dcz) for incremental bundle updates.

production_failures.symptom: Origin TTFB spikes by 300ms under load when serving dynamic SSR HTML
production_failures.root_cause: Reverse proxy was configured to run Brotli at quality 11 synchronously on every dynamic HTML response instead of quality 4-5.
production_failures.mitigation: Pre-compress static assets at Brotli quality 11 at build time, and cap dynamic SSR compression at quality 4 or 5.

production_failures.symptom: Shared dictionary never activates on subsequent app releases
production_failures.root_cause: The dictionary asset lacked a stable match pattern or was served with Cache-Control: no-store, preventing dictionary storage.
production_failures.mitigation: Emit Use-As-Dictionary: match="/assets/app.*.js" with long-lived Cache-Control headers and Vary: Available-Dictionary.
